class.name: Camera3D
class.brief_description: A camera that provides a view of a 3D scene.
class.description: A viewport uses one current camera at a time. This class exposes clip distances, the field of view, and the size used for an orthographic view.

method.name: SetNearClip
method.description: Sets the near clipping distance and updates the render camera. Does not clamp the value.
method.param: The near clipping distance in world units. For a perspective view, use a value greater than zero and less than the far distance.

method.name: GetNearClip
method.returns: The near clipping distance in world units.

method.name: SetFarClip
method.description: Sets the far clipping distance and updates the render camera. Does not clamp the value.
method.param: The far clipping distance in world units. Use a value greater than the near distance.

method.name: GetFarClip
method.returns: The far clipping distance in world units.

method.name: SetFovDegrees
method.description: Sets the vertical field of view for a perspective camera. Does not change the camera mode or clamp the value.
method.param: The vertical view angle in degrees. Use a value greater than 0 and less than 180.

method.name: GetFovDegrees
method.description: Gets the stored perspective field of view.
method.returns: The vertical field of view in degrees.

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Sets the height covered by an orthographic view. Does not change the camera mode or clamp the value.
method.param: The view height in world units. Use a positive value. The viewport shape determines the width.

method.name: GetSize
method.description: Gets the stored orthographic view size.
method.returns: The view height in world units. This setting does not affect a perspective view.
